title: kith-tui: two SSE parsers handle event: whitespace inconsistently
description: watch.rs uses strip_prefix("event: ") (requiring exactly one space) while client.rs uses strip_prefix("event:") + .trim() (any whitespace). An event:state frame (no space) is correctly parsed by client.rs but silently missed by watch.rs. Having two different SSE parsers in the same codebase with different rules is a maintenance hazard — one will break when the other works. Unify into one shared function or document the exact format both expect.
